finding.title: External RDP brute-force: >=5000 EventID 4625 logon failures (max_events cap, truncated) on SRL-FORGE
finding.description: Grounded in get_evtx over the ROCBA C-drive Security channel: at least 5000 EventID 4625 logon failures (result truncated at the 5000 max_events cap), provider Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing, computer SRL-FORGE, burst around 2020-11-16T02:03Z. Maps to MITRE T1110.003 (Password Spraying / Brute Force: RDP).
